description: Framework for integrating a deterministic associative recombination engine (TF-IDF + graph traversal) into a knowledge-management system's session lifecycle, including session hook wiring, Tier 0 hint extension, scheduled rebuild, and entity persistence.

required.name: corpus_config.json
required.description: Ingest surface paths, forbidden paths, threshold, max dreams

required.name: integration_config.json
required.description: Hook surface path, output surface path, scheduling mechanism

optional.name: persistence_config.json
optional.description: Entity types and persistence options — if omitted, entity persistence is skipped

gates: Privacy floor: no PII, credentials, or client data in dream corpus
Advisory surface: dreams must not block session boot on failure
Deterministic: same corpus → same output, no LLM in the scoring pass
Schema coexistence: entity persistence tables must not couple to concept tables
Launchd non-overlap: scheduled rebuild must not conflict with existing jobs
expected_outcomes: Deterministic associative engine rebuilding at session start
Non-obvious associations surfaced in operator-facing glanceable output
Scheduled periodic rebuild keeping associations fresh
Entity persistence layer for simulated entities, no coupling to concept tables
hardening_opportunity: If entity persistence proves reliable, it becomes the canonical state store for all simulated entities — single source of truth for world-state across sessions.
